rationale: The source provides direct empirical data demonstrating that LLMs have high false rejection rates (flagging correct code) compared to much lower false acceptance rates (missing non-compliant code), directly supporting the claim of an asymmetric false-rejection bias.
what_source_actually_says: The source explicitly states that LLMs over-flag correct code as failing at rates far higher than they miss genuinely non-compliant code, citing GPT-4o false acceptance rates of 3.70% vs false rejection rates of 35.9% (which worsen with explanation prompts).
scope_caveat: The empirical data specifically references benchmarks like MBPP and HumanEval.
